data.name: Expand_KindsHeader
data.value: Messages to expand
data.comment: Group heading. Which kinds of ICU message the task restructures.

data.name: Expand_Cardinal
data.value: Plural messages ({count, plural, ...})
data.comment: Tick box. The bracketed part is ICU syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_Ordinal
data.value: Ordinal messages ({count, selectordinal, ...})
data.comment: Tick box. Ordinals are 1st, 2nd, 3rd. The bracketed part is ICU syntax and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_KindsHint
data.value: A message is restructured into one segment per form the target language needs, each a whole sentence. A message whose only selectors are of an unticked kind is left as it is.
data.comment: Hint under the two tick boxes.

data.name: Expand_SeedHeader
data.value: Source text for forms the source language does not have
data.comment: Group heading. English has two plural forms; Russian needs four, so two of the Russian segments have no exact English counterpart and start from an English form chosen here.

data.name: Expand_SeedMatching
data.value: The source form with the same name where there is one, otherwise the "other" form
data.comment: Radio button, the default. "other" is the ICU keyword and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_SeedAlwaysOther
data.value: Always the "other" form
data.comment: Radio button. "other" is the ICU keyword and must not be translated.

data.name: Expand_SeedHint
data.value: The comment on each segment says which source form it started from, so the translator knows when the source is only a starting point.
data.comment: Hint under the two radio buttons.

data.name: Expand_HintsHeader
data.value: Segment comments
data.comment: Group heading. What the task writes into the comment on each source segment.

data.name: Expand_Hints
data.value: Add a grammar hint for the form where one is known
data.comment: Tick box, on by default.

data.name: Expand_HintsHint
data.value: Every comment names the form and example counts that select it. A hint adds a sentence on what the form usually requires, for example the genitive singular in Russian.
data.comment: Hint under the tick box. "genitive singular" is a grammatical case; translate it as a grammarian would.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHeader
data.value: Branch budget
data.comment: Group heading. A cap on how many segments one message may become.

data.name: Expand_BudgetLabel
data.value: Most segments one message may expand to:
data.comment: Label before a number box. The default is 24.

data.name: Expand_BudgetHint
data.value: Two independent plurals multiply: six forms times six forms is 36 segments for Arabic. Over the budget the message is laid out with its syntax protected but no forms added, and the report says so.
data.comment: Hint under the number box.

data.name: Expand_BudgetInvalid
data.value: Enter a whole number from 1 to 999.
data.comment: Validation message shown when the number box holds something else.

data.name: Expand_ParseHeader
data.value: When a value does not parse as an ICU message
data.comment: Group heading. What the task does with a value that has braces but is not valid ICU.

data.name: Expand_ParsePassThrough
data.value: Leave it untouched and add a warning
data.comment: Radio button, the default.

data.name: Expand_ParseFail
data.value: Stop the task
data.comment: Radio button. The whole batch task fails on the first such value.

data.name: Finalise_Intro
data.value: Finalise prunes each message to the forms the target language needs, escapes ICU special characters typed as text, and checks the placeholders. Warnings go on the source segment's comment and into the task report; target comments are never written.
data.comment: Paragraph at the top of the page.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyHeader
data.value: When a form has no translation
data.comment: Group heading. A required segment whose target is empty.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyUseSource
data.value: Use the source text and add a warning
data.comment: Radio button, the default.

data.name: Finalise_EmptyFail
data.value: Stop the task
data.comment: Radio button. The whole batch task fails on the first empty form.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchHeader
data.value: When the protected placeholders in source and target differ
data.comment: Group heading. A placeholder such as {name} missing from the translation or added to it.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchWarn
data.value: Add a warning and continue
data.comment: Radio button, the default.

data.name: Finalise_MismatchFail
data.value: Stop the task
data.comment: Radio button. The whole batch task fails on the first mismatch.
